changes.name: Early Game Rebalance
changes.summary: Part of Road to Restoration, aimed at smoothing early-game progression and rebalancing neglected XP/content curves.
changes.league_impact: Older early-game training routes may no longer represent the fastest or intended progression path.

changes.name: Combat Style Modernisation
changes.summary: Raised Attack, Strength, Ranged and Magic progression to 120 and substantially modernised Melee/Ranged/Magic kits around clearer style identities.
changes.league_impact: Any build planner must use post-modernisation ability behavior rather than 2024/2025 rotations.

changes.name: DailyScape Overhaul / RuneMetrics changes
changes.summary: Road to Restoration update reducing daily friction and modernising recurring systems.
changes.league_impact: Secondary; retain for chronology but do not model as a combat multiplier unless a specific League interaction is confirmed.

changes.name: Havenhythe Part 1 + Hunter 110
changes.summary: Introduced Havenhythe, raised Hunter to 110, added new Big Game Hunter encounters, birdhouses, clockwork traps, new combat encounters and Ranged armour progression.
changes.league_impact: Havenhythe is a starting Equilibrium region, making its 2026 Hunter and Ranged progression immediately relevant.

changes.name: Aura Overhaul
changes.summary: Removed the old aura system as a timed power layer and redistributed, retired or transformed its useful effects.
changes.league_impact: Catalyst-era guides built around aura uptime, aura refreshes or Berserker/Maniacal/Reckless assumptions are legacy-only.

changes.name: Dungeoneering Refresh & Remaster
changes.summary: Rebalanced floor XP, added XP from in-dungeon actions, modernised doors/content and reviewed bosses/mobs and reward progression.
changes.league_impact: Forinthry's Daemonheim value must be evaluated using post-remaster XP and unlock economics rather than old floor guides.

changes.name: Moonrise Dig Site
changes.summary: Moonrise launched as a live First Age/Guthixian Archaeology dig site on Havenhythe. Access requires Secrets of Amberfell and 52 Archaeology.
changes.league_impact: Moonrise is starting-region Archaeology progression in Equilibrium, not future Havenhythe content.

changes.name: Player-Owned Housing Rework + Construction 120
changes.summary: Player-Owned Housing was rebuilt and Construction's level cap increased to 120, adding new post-99 progression, recipes, utilities and housing systems.
changes.league_impact: Construction planning must use the post-July-13 progression; the July 20 rebalance then changed high-level XP and Eternal-plank value again.

changes.name: Mid-Game Rebalance
changes.summary: Rebalanced Fletching, Agility, Divination, God Wars progression, Invention perks, Construction 99-120 progression, resource loops, boss instance costs and selected drop rates.
changes.league_impact: Treat older Wilderness Agility, pre-retier Fletching, launch-week Construction and other outdated progression rates as stale until individually rechecked.

changes.name: Leagues II: EQUILIBRIUM countdown reveal
changes.summary: Confirmed the August 10 launch, region locking, seven Relic tiers, eight Blessing tiers, starting regions, selectable regions and Tier 1 relics.
changes.league_impact: Primary ruleset source for the dataset.
